metadata.question: On August 3, 2025, were there more than 30 fires active in Manitoba, Canada?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) data from MODIS or VIIRS - Collection: "FIRMS" in GEE is available as "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (daily) or "MODIS/FIRMS" - Better option: Use FIRMS near real-time data - typically available as MODIS/061/MCD14DL or similar - Actually, the best collection is "FIRMS" which provides active fire detections - Date: August 3, 2025 (single day) - Location: Manitoba, Canada (need to define geometry) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire data - Just count fire detections within Manitoba boundaries - Filter by confidence if needed to avoid false positives 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If collection is empty (no images for that date) → C1 - If we get a valid count (including 0) → Compare to 30 for A/B - If calculation fails → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Manitoba, Canada geometry const manitoba = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Canada'), ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Manitoba') )); // 2. Get Manitoba geometry const manitobaGeom = manitoba.geometry(); // 3. Define date range for August 3, 2025 const startDate = '2025-08-03'; const endDate = '2025-08-04'; // 4. Load FIRMS fire data (MODIS active fire product) let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(manitobaGeom); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try VIIRS as fallback fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(manitobaGeom); const fallbackSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fallback collection size: ${fallbackSize}`); if (fallbackSize === 0) { console.log("No fire data available for August 3, 2025"); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 5. Process fire detections const fireImage = fireCollection.first(); const fireMask = fireImage.select('FireMask'); // FireMask values: 7-9 are fire pixels (7=low, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence) const activeFires = fireMask.gte(7).and(fireMask.lte(9)); // 6. Count fire pixels in Manitoba const fireCount = activeFires.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: manitobaGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const firePixels = fireCount.get('FireMask').getInfo(); if (firePixels === null || firePixels === undefined) { console.log("Fire count calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Active fire pixels detected: ${firePixels}`); // 7. Determine answer if (firePixels > 30) { console.log("More than 30 fires detected"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("30 or fewer fires detected"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
